g.text: SCP is not a full transitive reduction: A2-1 → A4-4 (amber) is still implied by A2-1 → A2-2 → A3-2 → A3-3 → A4-3 → A4-4, because it is the only (hence latest) candidate in S[W41]. In a

g.text: 1835-plan random test, 15% of SCP graphs kept at least one such edge. Harmless for correctness; it only means 'at most one type-2 edge per action', not 'minimal'.

g.text: Type-2 edges: 15 in the original ADG (figure 2.4) → 12 after dropping the two waits (CP finds exactly these) → 8 with SCP. Red dashed: the 4 edges SCP skips;
